module: Cookie-bound Web session coordination and safe401 recovery

baseline.actualFinding: Twice reproduced second-tab refresh consuming the first-tab SID; first-tab next GET401 led to login despite the shared browser cookie remaining valid. Diagnostic PASS means bug reproduced, not feature accepted.
baseline.rejectedHypothesis: ACTIVE activationPending membership cannot be persisted because existing migration020 membership_activation_required rejects23514; invariant verified rather than weakened. Failed exploratory probe retained.

implementation: GET/auth/web-session validates current HttpOnly-cookie hash, bearer SID/user, WEB transport, unconsumed/unrevoked/unexpired session, active user/membership/role/tenant and exact selected context including null bootstrap. Validation does not issue credentials, set cookies or consume a refresh session.

Same-origin Web Lock serializes full refresh plus cookie verification, login, context and logout across tabs. BroadcastChannel carries only ephemeral access candidates or invalidation/logout signals. Every candidate is verified against the CURRENT cookie; valid foreign-user/family bearer is rejected. No local/sessionStorage credentials or persistent PII.

Monotonic four-minute renewal avoids dependence on device wall clock. Visibility and actual401 recover through the same lock. Same verified identity/context preserves drafts and cache. Identity/context changes clear and cancel queries, reject old-revision responses and replace stale deep links before new scope renders.

GET may retry only once with the same verified scope/revision; POST/PATCH/DELETE are never automatically replayed. Actual financialPOST401 returns to the form; explicit user retry produces the sole payment. Lost context-switch response adopts actual cookie-bound server outcome without repeating itsPOST.

Network verification failures expose labelled retry/pending/error feedback; login waits for initial verification. Logout failure does not falsely claim confirmed server logout. Existing session-reuse family revocation, platform MFA/audiences and native SecureStore transport are unchanged. Browsers lacking WebLocks/BroadcastChannel receive an explicit upgrade requirement.
testEvidence: Five new realPG/API cases verify current-cookie binding, missing/foreign/same-user-different-family cookie rejection, null-context staleness, validation nonconsumption, real refresh/reuse revocation, removed role/suspended tenant, truly expired signed JWT and MOBILE transport denial while native/me remains valid.

Eight actual browser cases: two tabs/reloads/sharedcookie/draft retention; cross-tenant switch/logout invalidation; actual external rotation and clock-skew-tolerant renewal; actual financialPOST401/no replay/one explicit successful receipt; committed lost switch-context response/no repeat; injected valid foreign-family peer candidate rejected and explicit different-user login propagated; real delayed owner audit bytes excluded after manager switch; actual verification transport abort/accessible retry with restored actual cookie state.
